did.description: The account whose queue to purge. Omitted = the requester's own account. A requester without administrative standing may name only itself.

peer.description: Only messages exchanged with this counterparty: in a send queue, the recipient; in a receive queue, the sender.

olderThanSeconds.description: Only messages queued at least this long.

dryRun.description: Report what would be purged and purge nothing. Default false.

Response.title: Messaging — Purge Queue — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/queue/purge request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/queue/purge/0.1#response.

purged.description: Messages actually removed. 0 on a dry run.
